subject.title: refactor(agents): reuse markdown code span formatter

question: Should a maintainer approve this behavior-preserving consolidation of embedded-agent Markdown formatting onto the shared helper?
rationale: The PR is authored by a repository member and labeled `maintainer`, so repository policy requires explicit maintainer judgment even though the supplied patch is narrow and validation is positive.

options.title: Approve the consolidation
options.body: Confirm that the shared formatter is the intended canonical contract for embedded-agent payloads and merge after normal required checks complete.

options.title: Keep a local formatter
options.body: Reject the consolidation only if the embedded-agent payload surface intentionally needs formatting semantics distinct from the shared Markdown helper.

recommendation.title: Approve the consolidation
